notes: Finding the Wardens' Shrine now teaches your wanderer a permanent way back there. Fall after reaching it and the Reach returns you to the shrine instead of the starter cave.
The unlocked waypoint survives closing and reopening the game. Reaching it again never grants the same reward twice.
If saving is interrupted, the way back still works for the current waking and the game keeps trying to remember it without applying the reward again.
title: The Wardens' Shrine becomes a lasting way back
